z.introBody: Z-Trigger can suggest starting a session when your phone disconnects from your car’s Bluetooth. It is optional, off by default and never required to use Zpot.

z.declined: Z-Trigger stays off. Zpot works fully without it.

z.disabledFlag: Z-Trigger is disabled on the server.
